briefings.title: Bill Gates calls AI ‘the most dangerous technology’ ever invented
briefings.tldr: Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates warns that AI is the most dangerous technology ever invented—surpassing the societal impact of personal computers and the internet—and asserts that self-governance by tech companies is entirely insufficient to prevent catastrophic misuse.

briefings.title: Secretary Rubio Delivers Remarks from the Acropolis in Athens
briefings.tldr: Secretary of State Marco Rubio delivered remarks from the Acropolis in Athens, arguing that the West must reject modern cultural self-doubt and reclaim its classical heritage of ambition, nationalism, and power projection.

briefings.title: LIVE: President Trump and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick make an announcement — 9/30/2026
briefings.tldr: President Donald Trump and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick announced a historic energy infrastructure package funded by up to $200 billion in South Korean investments, featuring a 6-gigawatt power plant in Texas, eight large-scale nuclear reactors, and the Alaska LNG pipeline.

briefings.title: President Trump Makes an Announcement with the Secretary of Commerce
briefings.tldr: President Trump announced a historic $200 billion energy infrastructure investment package funded by South Korea, featuring eight nuclear reactors, a Texas power generation facility, and the long-awaited Alaska LNG pipeline.

briefings.title: STATE OF THE FORCE ADDRESS
briefings.tldr: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth delivered the 2026 State of the Force Address at Marine Corps Base Quantico, declaring a permanent shift toward a merit-based, warfighting-focused culture and announcing six major structural initiatives spanning autonomous warfare, future strategy, domestic resilience, a new military base, academic commissioning pipelines, and spiritual support.

briefings.title: BREAKING NEWS: Trump, Mark Zuckerberg, Dario Amodei, And More Discuss New AI Standards Accords
briefings.tldr: President Trump and top tech leaders announced the formal signing of the "White House Accord on Super Intelligence," officially rebranding AI to SI (super intelligence) and committing to voluntary internal controls, multi-layered audits, and community partnerships to maintain U.S. dominance over China while driving historic economic growth.

briefings.title: President Trump, Elon Musk Announce AI-Powered "America.gov"
briefings.tldr: President Trump, Elon Musk, and administration officials announced the launch of America.gov, an AI-powered portal designed to consolidate government services into a single interface.

briefings.title: President Trump announces the launch of America.gov — 9/29/2026
briefings.tldr: President Donald Trump launched America.gov, a single digital portal designed to consolidate thousands of cumbersome government websites and over 10,000 forms into a palm-sized interface, aiming to return 10 billion hours of paperwork back to Americans.

briefings.title: Trump and AI Tech Executives Speak to Reporters After Meeting
briefings.tldr: President Trump, House Speaker Mike Johnson, and tech executives (including Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, Sam Altman, Dario Amodei, Mark Zuckerberg, and Sundar Pichai) announced a White House accord committing the industry to self-regulation, safety controls, and community partnerships as they build out superintelligence infrastructure.

briefings.title: Vice President JD Vance Holds a Fireside Chat
briefings.tldr: Vice President JD Vance emphasized that AI developers must take product liability for safety rather than relying on heavy-handed government regulation, while detailing the administration's interagency task force efforts to combat systemic welfare and healthcare fraud.

briefings.title: President Trump announces Mesabi Metallics’ plan to invest in a steel plant in Iowa — 9/28/26
briefings.tldr: President Trump announced a historic $18 billion investment by Mesabi Metallics (SR Group) to build the largest steel plant in U.S. history in southeastern Iowa, backed by a related $2.5 billion iron ore mine in Minnesota.

briefings.title: Trump threatens EU tariffs over Canada’s new partnership plan | DW News
briefings.tldr: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has welcomed a proposal for Canada to become the EU's first associate member to safeguard sovereignty and diversify trade amid ongoing tariffs with the US, drawing sharp criticism and tariff threats from US President Donald Trump.

briefings.title: Jensen Huang: The Doomer Hoax, Superintelligence is Here, and The Future of AI (ft. President Trump)
briefings.tldr: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dismisses "doomer" AI predictions and apocalyptic regulation as a hoax, arguing that AI is already achieving superintelligence in narrow domains while driving an unprecedented industrial revolution.

briefings.title: Commerce Sec. Lutnick and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang in a fireside chat at G20 meeting — 9/2/2026
briefings.tldr: Jensen Huang and Howard Lutnick discussed AI as the greatest platform shift in human history, framing it as physical economic infrastructure that manufactures digital intelligence (measured in tokens) akin to electricity.

briefings.title: Commerce Sec. Lutnick and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman participate in a fireside chat — 9/2/2026
briefings.tldr: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick discussed the trajectory of artificial intelligence at the G20 Innovation Ministerial, framing AI as a transformative economic engine comparable to electricity or the industrial revolution.

briefings.title: Inside Trump's Science Agenda: Anti-Science Claims, Fauci's Damage, DEI & China w/ Michael Kratsios
briefings.tldr: The White House Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP) is overhauling federal science funding through its new "Science: A New Golden Age" initiative to eliminate administrative bloat, defund political mandates, and aggressively back high-impact breakthroughs.

briefings.title: President Trump delivers remarks with technology leaders — 8/19/2026
briefings.tldr: President Trump and top financial and technology leaders met at the White House ahead of the CFTC's Innovation Advisory Committee, highlighting historic regulatory shifts, a booming US stock market, and massive investments in crypto and AI.

briefings.title: President Trump Hosts a Roundtable on American Mining
briefings.tldr: President Trump hosted a roundtable at the Department of State with cabinet officials, mining executives, and academic leaders to announce historic multi-billion dollar investments in domestic critical minerals, accelerated permitting timelines, and a $100 million initiative to train the next generation of American mining engineers.

briefings.title: President Trump Makes an Announcement on the Ratepayer Protection Pledge
briefings.tldr: President Trump announced that over 220 entities have signed the Ratepayer Protection Pledge, requiring major tech companies and AI data centers to fund or build their own energy infrastructure to prevent consumer rate hikes while keeping the U.S. ahead in AI and manufacturing.

briefings.title: President Trump Participates in a Pennsylvania Defense and Innovation Summit
briefings.tldr: President Trump announced nearly $10 billion in new defense industrial base investments in Pennsylvania—projected to reach $20 billion—aimed at creating over 4,000 jobs and revitalizing the "Arsenal of Freedom" through aggressive deregulation, merit-based recruitment, and private-sector innovation.

briefings.title: President Trump on The Axios Show | Full Interview
briefings.tldr: President Trump asserts that his second term represents a more "judicious" and "powerful" exercise of authority than his first, characterized by a "no limits" approach to military power and clear dominance over global adversaries and technology.

briefings.title: President Trump Participates in the Launch of Trump Accounts
briefings.tldr: President Trump and top financial and corporate leaders launched "Trump accounts" in the Oval Office—a new program providing every newborn American child with a $1,000 seed contribution and corporate backing to build an ownership economy through equity markets.

briefings.title: FULL GAGGLE: Rubio Takes Questions From Reporters Amid Meetings With Gulf Leaders Over Iran Deal
briefings.tldr: Secretary of State Marco Rubio reaffirmed the United States' concrete security commitments to Gulf allies during ongoing nuclear negotiations with Iran, emphasizing that any final deal must be robust, international waterways must remain free of tolls, and the U.S. remains prepared to leverage sanctions if commitments are broken.

briefings.title: Donald Trump LIVE: Trump Drops BOMBSHELL on India-US Trade Deal | PM Modi | Trump Tariffs |Trade War
briefings.tldr: President Donald Trump announced a massive $700 million federal revitalization of the U.S. coal sector—including invoking the Defense Production Act to save 13 coal plants—while declaring that a major bilateral trade deal with India is "around the corner" despite historical tariff imbalances.

briefings.title: Trump Xi Summit LIVE: Why Is Team Trump Under Digital Lockdown During China Visit? | Vantage
briefings.tldr: President Trump and a delegation of top U.S. business leaders are under a strict "digital lockdown" during their visit to China, utilizing temporary "clean" devices and vetted software to mitigate the extreme risk of sophisticated state-sponsored cyber surveillance.

briefings.tldr: The Middle East is on the brink of total war as Israel eliminates top Hezbollah and Hamas leadership, prompting Iran to mobilize hypersonic missiles and reject diplomatic deals with the U.S. until blockades are lifted.

briefings.title: Marco Rubio BREAKS DOWN America’s GLOBAL GEOPOLITICS in MASTERFUL Press Conference
briefings.tldr: Secretary Marco Rubio emphasized a "U.S. interest first" foreign policy, issuing a stern warning to Iran against seizing international waterways while leveraging the Catholic Church’s global influence to facilitate humanitarian aid in Cuba and Africa.

briefings.title: President Donald Trump delivers remarks at the White House — 5/8/2026
briefings.tldr: President Trump delivered a Mother’s Day address honoring "Angel Moms" and "Gold Star Moms" while highlighting his administration’s claims of achieving zero illegal border crossings, drastic reductions in drug prices, and new financial incentives for American families.

briefings.title: President Trump Delivers Remarks, May 8, 2026
briefings.tldr: President Trump hosted a Rose Garden event to honor Mother’s Day, specifically recognizing "Angel Moms" and Gold Star families while highlighting administration successes in border security, drug price reduction, and family-focused economic incentives.

briefings.title: President Trump Delivers Remarks in the Rose Garden
briefings.tldr: President Trump utilized a Rose Garden Mother’s Day event to honor "Angel Moms" and "Gold Star Moms," while detailing administration achievements in border security, drug interdiction, and new economic incentives for American families.

briefings.title: Secretary of State Rubio Speaks to Reporters in Rome
briefings.tldr: Secretary of State Marco Rubio’s visit to Rome focused on aligning with the Vatican and the Italian government on global security threats, specifically Iran’s maritime aggression and the need for humanitarian corridors in Cuba and Sudan.

briefings.title: "Unacceptable": Marco Rubio says Iran must never get nuclear weapons in briefing to media
briefings.tldr: Secretary of State Marco Rubio declared that Iran’s pursuit of nuclear weapons and attempts to control international waterways are "unacceptable," while affirming that the U.S. will maintain a policy of immediate military retaliation against any threats to American personnel or assets.

briefings.title: Why Trump Can't Stand Still: The Iran War He Doesn't Know How to End
briefings.tldr: The Trump administration is reportedly nearing a framework agreement to end the war with Iran and begin a 30-day negotiation period, even as military readiness declines and a diplomatic rift with Germany triggers a significant drawdown of U.S. troops in Europe.

briefings.tldr: President Trump hosted the 2026 National Small Business Week Award winners to celebrate the U.S. small business sector’s contribution to the economy and to highlight his administration's "Great Big Beautiful Bill," which focuses on aggressive deregulation, significant tax cuts, and record-breaking capital investment.
